title: Coronado Fups Hi-tensile alloy Road Train Bullbar #9
description: Coronado FUPS compliant hi-tensile aluminium heavy duty road train bull bar. 6mm wall heavy duty box uprights extended through to lower main protection bar fitted with 3 cow catchers supports in lower main bar for maximum protection. Main cross tubes are one piece high tensile tube, no but welds, passing through the centre box uprights and recessed into outer uprights. Driving light mounts to customer specification. Indicator/daylight running lights above main channel. Stick-on Road Train signs with removable covers. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin.
